verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical: the original was simply shrunk into the middle of the 728x90 canvas. The illustration clusters are pulled inward, which leaves empty navy bands about 95px wide at both ends, and the figures are cramped and cut off at the top. CLAYTONI and CREATIVE AGENCY stay readable and on brand, with the right hierarchy and no collisions, but this is a scale-down rather than a real re-layout for the leaderboard format.
